request.project_task: Create a parcel tracking and delivery confirmation service.
request.project_goal: Give senders and recipients a reliable parcel status.
request.project_description: Carrier events update parcel status; the recipient confirms delivery or reports a problem.

functional_requirements.text: A sender creates a shipment with recipient details.

atoms.text: A sender creates a shipment with recipient details.

functional_requirements.text: A carrier posts parcel scan events.

atoms.text: A carrier posts parcel scan events.

functional_requirements.text: The system derives the current parcel status from accepted events.

atoms.text: The system derives the current parcel status from accepted events.

functional_requirements.text: A recipient views the current status.

atoms.text: A recipient views the current status.

functional_requirements.text: A recipient confirms delivery or reports damage.

atoms.text: A recipient confirms delivery or reports damage.

non_functional_requirements.text: Duplicate carrier events must be idempotent.
Tracking history must be retained for one year.

actors.name: Sender
actors.description: Person or organization that creates a shipment with recipient details.

actors.name: Carrier
actors.description: Logistics provider that posts parcel scan events.

actors.name: Recipient
actors.description: Person who receives the parcel and views status or confirms delivery/reports damage.

actors.name: System
actors.description: Parcel Track service that derives status and retains history.

use_cases.name: Create Shipment
use_cases.goal: A sender creates a shipment with recipient details so the parcel can be tracked.
use_cases.trigger: Sender initiates creation of a new shipment.

preconditions.text: Sender is authenticated and authorized to create shipments.

success_postconditions.text: A new shipment exists with recipient details and a unique tracking identifier.

failure_postconditions.text: No shipment is created; sender is informed of the failure.

steps.action: Sender provides recipient details and shipment information.
System validates recipient details and creates the shipment.
steps.expected_result: Shipment is created with a unique tracking identifier.

steps.action: System returns the tracking identifier to the sender.
steps.expected_result: Sender receives confirmation and tracking identifier.

steps.action: Sender provides invalid or incomplete recipient details.
System rejects the shipment creation and returns validation errors.
steps.expected_result: No shipment is created; sender is informed.

user_stories.capability: create a shipment with recipient details
user_stories.benefit: the parcel can be tracked from the start

system_stories.system_action: Validate recipient details and persist a new shipment with a unique tracking identifier.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure shipment creation is atomic and returns a tracking identifier.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Create Shipment
Goal: A sender creates a shipment with recipient details so the parcel can be tracked.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Sender initiates creation of a new shipment.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: Sender is authenticated and authorized to create shipments.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Sender provides recipient details and shipment information.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] System validates recipient details and creates the shipment.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] System returns the tracking identifier to the sender.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: Invalid recipient details
Source FRs: FR-001

use_cases.name: Post Parcel Scan Event
use_cases.goal: A carrier posts parcel scan events so the system can update tracking status.
use_cases.trigger: Carrier scans a parcel at a checkpoint.

preconditions.text: Carrier is authenticated and authorized to post events.
The parcel exists in the system.

success_postconditions.text: The scan event is accepted and stored; duplicate events are ignored idempotently.

failure_postconditions.text: The scan event is rejected; no status change occurs.

main_success_scenario.name: Carrier posts a new scan event

steps.action: Carrier submits a parcel scan event with tracking identifier, timestamp, and location.
System validates the event and checks for duplicates.
steps.expected_result: Event is determined to be new and valid.

steps.action: System stores the event and updates the parcel status.
steps.expected_result: Event is persisted; current status is derived from accepted events.

steps.action: System acknowledges successful event processing.
Carrier submits a scan event that was already posted.
System detects the event as a duplicate and ignores it idempotently.
steps.expected_result: No duplicate event is stored; status remains unchanged.

steps.action: System acknowledges the event as already processed.
steps.expected_result: Carrier receives confirmation without side effects.

steps.action: Carrier submits a scan event with an unknown tracking identifier or invalid data.
System rejects the event and returns an error.
steps.expected_result: No event is stored; carrier is informed.

user_stories.benefit: the system can maintain accurate tracking status

system_stories.system_action: Validate, deduplicate, and persist carrier scan events; derive current parcel status.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure idempotent event processing and status derivation.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Post Parcel Scan Event
Goal: A carrier posts parcel scan events so the system can update tracking status.
Primary actor: ACT-002
Trigger: Carrier scans a parcel at a checkpoint.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: Carrier is authenticated and authorized to post events.
  - PRE-UC002-002: The parcel exists in the system.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Carrier submits a parcel scan event with tracking identifier, timestamp, and location.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] System validates the event and checks for duplicates.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] System stores the event and updates the parcel status.
  4. [STEP-UC002-004] System acknowledges successful event processing.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-ALT-001: Duplicate scan event
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Invalid or unknown parcel
Source FRs: FR-002, FR-003

use_cases.name: View Parcel Status
use_cases.goal: A recipient views the current parcel status.
use_cases.trigger: Recipient requests the current status of a parcel.

preconditions.text: Recipient is authenticated and authorized to view the parcel.
The parcel exists in the system.

success_postconditions.text: Recipient sees the current parcel status derived from accepted events.

failure_postconditions.text: Recipient is informed that status cannot be retrieved.

steps.action: Recipient requests the current status for a tracking identifier.
System retrieves accepted events and derives the current status.
System returns the current status to the recipient.
steps.expected_result: Recipient sees the current parcel status.

steps.action: Recipient requests status for an unknown or unauthorized parcel.
System returns an error and does not disclose status.

user_stories.benefit: I know where my parcel is

system_stories.system_action: Derive and return the current parcel status from accepted events.
system_stories.responsibility: Provide accurate and timely status to authorized recipients.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — View Parcel Status
Goal: A recipient views the current parcel status.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: Recipient requests the current status of a parcel.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: Recipient is authenticated and authorized to view the parcel.
  - PRE-UC003-002: The parcel exists in the system.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Recipient requests the current status for a tracking identifier.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] System retrieves accepted events and derives the current status.
  3. [STEP-UC003-003] System returns the current status to the recipient.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC003-EXC-001: Parcel not found or unauthorized
Source FRs: FR-003, FR-004

use_cases.name: Confirm Delivery or Report Damage
use_cases.goal: A recipient confirms delivery or reports damage for a parcel.
use_cases.trigger: Recipient receives the parcel and confirms delivery or reports damage.

preconditions.text: Recipient is authenticated and authorized to act on the parcel.
The parcel exists and is in a state that allows confirmation or damage report.

success_postconditions.text: Delivery confirmation or damage report is recorded and status is updated.

failure_postconditions.text: No confirmation or report is recorded; recipient is informed.

steps.action: Recipient confirms successful delivery of the parcel.
System records the delivery confirmation and updates the parcel status.
System acknowledges the confirmation.
Recipient reports damage to the parcel.
System records the damage report and updates the parcel status.
System acknowledges the damage report.
Recipient attempts to confirm delivery or report damage for an unknown or unauthorized parcel.
System rejects the action and returns an error.
steps.expected_result: No confirmation or report is recorded; recipient is informed.

user_stories.benefit: the sender and carrier know the final outcome

system_stories.system_action: Record delivery confirmation or damage report and update parcel status.
system_stories.responsibility: Ensure recipient actions are captured and reflected in status.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Confirm Delivery or Report Damage
Goal: A recipient confirms delivery or reports damage for a parcel.
Primary actor: ACT-003
Trigger: Recipient receives the parcel and confirms delivery or reports damage.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: Recipient is authenticated and authorized to act on the parcel.
  - PRE-UC004-002: The parcel exists and is in a state that allows confirmation or damage report.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Recipient confirms successful delivery of the parcel.
  2. [STEP-UC004-002] System records the delivery confirmation and updates the parcel status.
  3. [STEP-UC004-003] System acknowledges the confirmation.
Alternative scenarios:
  - SCN-UC004-ALT-001: Recipient reports damage
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC004-EXC-001: Invalid or unauthorized action
Source FRs: FR-005, FR-003
